content.value_statement: Backend services fail when edge cases, auth flows, and data changes are not tested. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create focused backend tests.
actual_capabilities: Plans unit tests for business logic, validation, and edge cases.
Drafts integration tests for REST endpoints, status codes, and response bodies.
Designs authentication and authorization tests for token and role behavior.
Shows how to isolate databases, fixtures, and external services in tests.
Provides coverage thresholds and CI-friendly test script guidance.
Covers Jest, Pytest, Mocha, Supertest, FastAPI TestClient, and JUnit patterns.
limitations: It needs project framework details before producing accurate tests.
It cannot verify tests without access to the project and test runner.
Generated examples may need adaptation to local models, routes, and fixtures.
It does not replace security review for production authentication code.

use_cases.title: Test a new API feature
use_cases.description: Create success, failure, validation, and database assertions for new REST endpoints before release.

use_cases.title: Prevent regression after a bug fix
use_cases.description: Turn a reported backend defect into repeatable unit or integration tests that guard expected behavior.

use_cases.title: Prepare CI test coverage
use_cases.description: Define test commands, coverage thresholds, and isolation rules for automated backend test pipelines.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic unit test
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for focused business logic coverage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write unit tests for this backend function. Use my framework and include success, failure, and edge cases.

prompt_templates.title: Test an API endpoint
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for route-level integration tests.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create integration tests for these REST endpoints. Cover status codes, request validation, response fields, and database changes.

prompt_templates.title: Cover authentication flows
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for token and role behavior.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design tests for registration, login, protected routes, expired tokens, invalid tokens, and role-based access control.

prompt_templates.title: Build a test strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for broad backend coverage planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this backend service and propose a complete test strategy with unit tests, integration tests, mocks, fixtures, and CI coverage gates.

output_examples.input: Test a user registration endpoint with duplicate email handling.
output: A registration test plan with valid signup, duplicate email, weak password, and missing field cases.
Assertions for status codes, response fields, and persisted user records.
Fixture and database reset guidance for independent test runs.

output_examples.input: Add tests for an email service that calls a third-party provider.
output: A mock-based service test approach that avoids real network calls.
Success and provider failure scenarios with clear assertions.
Guidance to keep API keys in test environment variables.

output_examples.input: Set up backend tests for a CI pipeline.
output: Recommended test scripts for normal, watch, coverage, and CI runs.
Coverage threshold guidance for branches, functions, lines, and statements.
Cleanup requirements for database connections and server handles.

best_practices: Reset database and service state before each test to keep tests independent.
Mock external APIs, email providers, payment services, and time-based behavior.
Use clear test names that describe the behavior and expected result.
anti_patterns: Do not run tests against production databases or live customer data.
Do not depend on test execution order or shared mutable state.
Do not use sleeps as a substitute for deterministic async control.

faq.question: Which backend frameworks does this skill support?
faq.answer: It covers common patterns for Express, FastAPI, Django, Spring Boot, and similar service frameworks.

faq.question: Can it write both unit and integration tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It separates pure unit tests from endpoint, database, authentication, and external service integration tests.

faq.question: Does it require a real database?
faq.answer: No. It recommends isolated test databases, in-memory databases, fixtures, and cleanup steps.

faq.question: Will it call real external APIs during tests?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs users to mock external services and avoid real network calls in tests.

faq.question: Can it help with test coverage targets?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests coverage thresholds and CI commands that match the selected test framework.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the framework, test tool, target code or endpoints, database choice, and required coverage goal.
